collectRewards(address).details: Permissionless entry point. Pays the caller a keeper reward off      the paired-side fees before distributing the remainder to the      configured `rewardRecipients`. See `_payKeeperReward` for the      reward formula and the native-vs-ERC20 delivery semantics.

params.token: The ArtCoins token whose pool to collect from.

collectRewardsWithoutUnlock(address).details: For use from inside a hook callback where the V4 PoolManager is      already unlocked. NOT called by the hook. The function remains in      the contract surface for use by hook variants or pool extensions      that want to drive distribution from within an unlock context.      **Reward delivery to contract callers.** Like `collectRewards`,      this path pays the keeper reward to `msg.sender` in the      paired-side currency. If the calling contract has a payable      receive (native-ETH path), it will accept the ETH but holds no      sweep path by default — the contract that calls this MUST have      an intentional sink, sweep, or forwarding logic for the ETH.      For WETH-paired pools, the reward arrives as an ERC20 balance      with the same sweep-or-strand consideration. If the caller is      an unintended downstream contract (e.g., an extension fired      from within an afterSwap), the reward could land in a contract      with no withdrawal surface and strand. If this matters for      your integration, consider taking an explicit recipient      argument upstream of this call.

params.token: The ArtCoins token whose pool to collect from.

params.factory_: Address of the ArtCoins token factory.
params.feeLocker_: Address of the `ArtCoinsFeeEscrow` (must support native-ETH path).

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

params.lockerConfig: Locker-specific parameters (reward split, tick ranges, positions).
params.poolConfig: Pool parameters passed through from the factory.
params.poolSupply: Amount of ArtCoins token to deploy as liquidity.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

KEEPER_REWARD_BPS_MAX().notice: Upper bound on `keeperRewardBps`. Bounded narrow so a future         owner setter cannot meaningfully grief recipients — at the         max value, recipients still receive 98% of paired-side fees.

KEEPER_REWARD_CAP_MAX().notice: Upper bound on `keeperRewardCap`. Generous enough that the         owner can adapt to high-gas regimes; tight enough that a         single call can never claim more than 0.05 ETH from         recipients regardless of accumulation size.

KEEPER_REWARD_CAP_MIN().notice: Lower bound on `keeperRewardCap`. Even a fully-discounted gas         market should produce viable keeper economics at this cap.

MAX_LP_POSITIONS().notice: Maximum number of LP positions per token. 14 so PERMANENT         COLLECTION can carry its thin-floor taper PLUS two concentrated         high-FDV tail positions ($30M–$300M FDV coverage).

MAX_REWARD_PARTICIPANTS().notice: Maximum number of reward recipients per token.

collectRewards(address).notice: Collects fees from the Uniswap v4 pool and distributes them to reward recipients.

collectRewardsWithoutUnlock(address).notice: Same as `collectRewards` but assumes the pool manager is already unlocked.

feeLocker().notice: Fee escrow that holds distributed rewards (ERC20 + native ETH).

keeperRewardBps().notice: Keeper-reward bps applied to the paired-side fee amount on         each `collectRewards` call. Paid to `msg.sender`. Bounded by         `KEEPER_REWARD_BPS_MAX`. Default 50 (0.5%).

keeperRewardCap().notice: Absolute cap on the keeper reward per call. Once accrued         paired-side fees are large enough that bps × amount exceeds         the cap, the keeper takes exactly the cap and recipients keep         everything above. Default 0.01 ETH. Bounded by         `KEEPER_REWARD_CAP_MIN` and `KEEPER_REWARD_CAP_MAX`.

onERC721Received(address,address,uint256.notice: ERC-721 receiver for incoming LP NFTs; restricted to factory transfers.

permit2().notice: Permit2 instance used to grant approvals to the position manager.

placeLiquidity((address,address[],addres.notice: Called by the factory to lock the initial LP and configure reward distribution.

setKeeperRewardBps(uint256).notice: Updates the keeper-reward bps applied to paired-side fees on         each `collectRewards` call. Owner only. Bounded by         `KEEPER_REWARD_BPS_MAX` so the owner can never grief         recipients beyond a small fixed ceiling.

setKeeperRewardCap(uint256).notice: Updates the absolute per-call cap on the keeper reward. Owner         only. Bounded by `KEEPER_REWARD_CAP_MIN` and         `KEEPER_REWARD_CAP_MAX`. The lower bound prevents the owner         from setting the cap so low that keepers stop calling.

tokenRewards(address).notice: Returns stored reward distribution info for a given token.

updateRewardAdmin(address,uint256,addres.notice: Replaces the reward admin at `rewardIndex` for a token.         Only the slot's current admin may call.

updateRewardRecipient(address,uint256,ad.notice: Replaces the reward recipient at `rewardIndex` for a token.         Only the slot's admin may call.

withdrawERC20(address,address).notice: Sweeps an ERC20 balance held by the locker to a recipient. Owner only.

withdrawETH(address).notice: Sweeps ETH held by the locker to a recipient. Owner only.
